title: Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces Reimbursement Ledger Rule: Recoupment of a Paid Rental Month
content:
For Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces, a recoupment is recorded against the one paid month it takes back, as the original paid month it reverses; a paid month is reversed at most once. A month overlapping a hospice election is reversed with the reason hospice overlap. Every patient charge stemming from the reversed month is removed under the coverage charter.

A reversal takes one paid rental month back from the paid capped rental months of the bed in the current rental period.

## Ledger treatment

1. **One reversal, one paid month.** Each recoupment names the single paid month it takes back.
2. **At most once.** A paid month that already has a reversal recorded against it is not reversed again. The evidence is the system's billing record: whether a reversal naming that paid month already exists, read before the recoupment is recorded.
3. **Hospice overlap.** Where the reversed month overlaps a hospice election, the reversal carries the reason hospice overlap.
4. **Patient charges.** Every patient charge that stemmed from the reversed month — such as a cost share or an upgrade difference posted for it — is removed under the coverage charter (Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility).
5. **Month count.** The reversed month no longer counts as a paid capped rental month of the current rental period.

## Hypothetical ledger lines

| Hypothetical paid month | Reversal already recorded against it | Recoupment now received for it | Treatment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Month 7 | No | Yes | Recorded as the reversal of month 7; month 7 leaves the paid count |
| Month 7 | Yes | Yes | Not recorded again — month 7 has been reversed once |
| Month 9, overlapping a hospice election | No | Yes | Recorded as the reversal of month 9 with the reason hospice overlap |

### Hypothetical count

Ten paid months in the current rental period, of which one is reversed: the paid count stands at nine.
